name: SS Drottningholm
builder: Alexander Stephen & Sons, Linthouse / Glasgow, Scotland
summary: The Swedish American Line transatlantic liner best understood in two lives: first as Allan Line’s turbine liner Virginian , completed in 1905 for the Canadian service, and later as Drottningholm , the Swedish American Line ship that linked Gothenburg and New York through the interwar years and into the Second World War era.
